privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Control what launcher checks, scans, and reports.
privacy.verifyFilesDesc: Scans your install folder and cross-checks file hashes against the manifest.
privacy.findSteamDesc: Searches your Steam library paths for zyphor titles. Useful if you moved the install.
privacy.malwareScanDesc: Runs a quick hash check of launcher binaries against known-good signatures.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Shares anonymous usage data to help improve the launcher experience.
privacy.crashReportsDesc: Automatically sends crash logs so issues can be investigated faster.
privacy.diagnosticsDesc: Sends GPU, CPU, and RAM info alongside crash reports.
privacy.personalisedDesc: Shows content tailored to your play history in the launcher home screen.
privacy.rememberLoginDesc: Keeps you signed in between launcher restarts.
privacy.clearSessionDesc: Signs you out and removes all cached login tokens.
